results.notes: Input: D:/projects/ai-skill-atlas/creativity-data/osf-3jqga/CreativeCollabAI_Study1.sav; outcome Expert_creativity; arm variable condition_coded, treatment=2 (Human-AI condition (editor)), control=1 (Human condition). The deposited file has one row and one already aggregated expert score per poem; the paper specifies one poem per person. Use the stored poem score as the participant-level outcome. Individual poets' ratings and participant IDs are not included, so the upstream rater aggregation cannot be independently reconstructed. There are no missing outcome scores, duplicated rows, or duplicated poem texts; poem text was checked for uniqueness, not used to exclude observations. All retained human rows pass the attention check after normalizing capitalization and surrounding quotes. No additional exclusions, imputation, outcome rescaling, or covariate adjustment were applied. Individual between-person randomization (PDF pp. 2, 4-5, 9); one assigned condition per person, so round='all' and no first_round result is applicable. SDs use n-1. Difference is treatment minus control in the original 1-40 creativity units. OLS includes an intercept and the binary treatment indicator for these two arms only; HC2 SE is verified against sqrt(s_treatment^2/n_treatment + s_control^2/n_control). There are no randomized clusters. Reproduction compares counts exactly, means/SDs to two decimal places and exact p-values to three decimal places, using decimal half-up rounding after removing binary floating-point noise. The printed p-values are reproduced with the three-arm ANOVA residual variance and two-sided LSD t-tests, following Syntax_NHB_CreativeCollabAI.pdf (read only as text). The new difference_se uses the requested pair-specific HC2 covariance. All three deposited files were SHA-256 verified against the supplied manifest. Table 1 and the results on PDF p. 4 provide the matching means/SDs and p<0.001; PDF pp. 2 and 4 provide 48 people in each human arm and 96 total. condition_coded=1 is human, 2 is editor, and 3 comprises 50 AI-only poems. The benchmark has no human demographics and is omitted from participant counts and the HC2 contrast, but retained in the original LSD error term. The human-arm mapping also reproduces the self-rating means in Table 1. The deposited file contains 96 human records and 50 benchmark poems, consistent with the paper's analyzed sample. It contains no excluded attention-check failures. The reported 101 recruits minus six exclusions does not equal 96; recruitment counts and the original excluded records cannot be recovered from this deposit. Separate diagnostic: the non-extracted three-arm omnibus is F(2, 143)=62.253921036424, whereas PDF p. 4 prints F(2,145)=63.48. That omnibus does not reproduce. The extracted two-arm means, SDs, people counts and pairwise p-value do reproduce, and are the reproduction gate for this result.
